source_name: Regnskaber — XBRL / Inline XBRL annual-report documents (DCCA taxonomy)
license: Free / open; same CVR reuse terms
catalog_basis: Observed from a real downloaded, gzip-decompressed XBRL instance: raw/samples/maersk_delaarsrapport.xbrl.xml (A.P. Møller - Mærsk A/S, CVR 22756214, Q1-2026 interim). The sample is a management-review/identity instance using the Danish DCCA taxonomy (fsa/gsd/cmn/sob) plus IFRS. It carries identity, address, board/management, period, and reporting-class facts; the income-statement / balance-sheet line items (fsa:) live in the same taxonomy and appear in full annual reports. Each fact references an xbrli:context that fixes the entity, period, and any dimensions (e.g. ConsolidatedMember vs SoloMember).

fields.meaning: CVR number of the entity the report is about. Join key back to CVR and the filing metadata.
fields.analysis_notes: Authoritative CVR for joining XBRL facts to the company.

fields.meaning: ISO 17442 Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) of the reporting entity (listed/IFRS filers).
fields.limitations: Present mainly for larger/listed entities; absent for most small companies.
fields.analysis_notes: Also appears as the xbrli:context entity identifier (scheme iso/17442). Use for cross-border / GLEIF linkage.

fields.meaning: Legal name of the reporting entity as stated in the report.
fields.limitations: Report-stated name; prefer CVR navne[] as the canonical name.
fields.analysis_notes: Cross-check against CVR; useful when base register is unavailable.

fields.meaning: Street name of the reporting entity's address.
fields.limitations: Part of a multi-field address group.
fields.analysis_notes: Combine with building id, post code, district, country.
Town component of the report address.

fields.meaning: Country of the reporting entity's address.
Start date of the reporting period covered by the figures.
fields.analysis_notes: Use to align with offentliggoerelser regnskabsperiode.

fields.meaning: End date of the reporting period covered by the figures.
fields.analysis_notes: Also PrecedingReportingPeriodStartDate/PredingReportingPeriodEndDate give prior-period comparatives (note the source typo 'Preding').

fields.meaning: Danish accounting reporting class (Regnskabsklasse A/B/C/D) governing disclosure requirements.
fields.analysis_notes: Indicates which financial line items to expect.

fields.meaning: Human-readable type of the submitted report.
fields.analysis_notes: Distinguishes interim vs full annual report.

fields.meaning: Level of auditor involvement (audit, review, assistance, none).
fields.analysis_notes: Audit status signal for the figures.

fields.meaning: Name of an executive-board (direktion) member; repeated per board member via a typed dimension (memberOfBoardIdentifier).
fields.analysis_notes: Each member sits in its own context (typedMember IdentificationOfMemberOfExecutiveBoardDimension).

fields.meaning: Title/role of the executive-board member (e.g. CEO, CFO).
fields.analysis_notes: Match to name by shared context id.

fields.meaning: Name of a supervisory-board (bestyrelse) member, with optional cmn:TitleOfMemberOfSupervisoryBoard (Chair/Vice Chair).

Monetary financial-statement facts from the DCCA fsa taxonomy: revenue, gross profit, operating/net profit-loss, total assets, equity, liabilities, etc. Each has a contextRef (period + consolidated/solo), a unitRef (currency), and a decimals attribute. NOT present in this identity/management-review interim sample but standard in full annual reports.
fields.code_list: DCCA fsa taxonomy (http://xbrl.dcca.dk/fsa); IFRS ifrs-full for class D/listed
fields.limitations: Not observed in the available sample (an interim management-review instance). Tag set differs by reporting class and GAAP (Danish GAAP vs IFRS/ESEF). Currency comes from the linked xbrli:unit (iso4217), commonly DKK.
fields.analysis_notes: Resolve each fact's contextRef to get the period and the ConsolidatedSoloDimension (cmn:ConsolidatedMember vs SoloMember); resolve unitRef for currency. Map concept QName -> internal line item.

fields.meaning: Dimension on each context marking whether the fact is consolidated (cmn:ConsolidatedMember) or parent-only/solo (cmn:SoloMember).
fields.limitations: Must be honoured to avoid mixing group and parent figures.
fields.analysis_notes: Always read the context dimensions before storing a financial fact.
